title: adenophora verticillata f. subintegrifolia
intro: Adenophora verticillata f. subintegrifolia, commonly known as Chinese bugbane or Adenophora, is a plant species in the Campanulaceae family. It is a perennial herb used in traditional medicine, particularly in East Asian countries, where it is valued for its diverse health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Adenophora verticillata f. subintegrifolia include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of respiratory tract infections and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
